notes: Data: ForJournals_a/Data/Clean/uctdata_balanced.dta (499 students x 2 rounds = working sample); estimation on the follow-up round. attempt-1 was an exploratory variable listing (no RESULT lines). Table 3: OLS of follow-up Race IAT (DscoreraceIAT) on mixracebas, baseline Race IAT (DscoreraceIATbas), own controls (Female, Falseuct2012, durpcabas_nomiss, consbas_nomiss, Foreign, privateschool_nomiss plus their missing dummies), roommate controls (roFalseuct2012, rodurpcabas_nomiss, roconsbas_nomiss, roForeign_bas, roprivschool_nomiss plus missing dummies), residence FE, SEs clustered by baseline room, separately for whites/blacks. Table 4: same controls without lagged outcome, residence + academic program (regprogram) FE in subsamples; full sample adds White/Coloured/Indian-Other dummies with race-group (Black/White/other) x residence FE and program FE. Performance index uses the dataset's PCAperf variable (labelled 'Performance index 2012, PCA'). attempt-2 (kind claim) gave identical coefficients but fixest dropped singleton FE groups (N 493 in Panel C); check_attempt reported all claims within tolerance, but since the paper's working sample is 499 the final run keeps singletons (fixef.rm='none'), which yields N=117/332/499 and standard errors matching the paper (e.g. 0.243, 0.125). Coefficients unchanged across attempt-2 and final. No run hung.
